== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Akura Charity]], also known as the [[Sage of the Silver Heart]], is a powerful figure within the [[Akura clan]] and an [[Archlady]] at the peak of the [[Lord realm]]. As a [[Sage]], she possesses a special status and [[Authority|authority]] that distinguishes her from typical [[Archlord|Archlords]]. She is characterized by her intense emotional control, cold logic, and a composed, cool demeanor that she maintains to represent her clan. Despite this mastery over herself, she remains human and must occasionally work to master her own feelings. Physically, she appears as a woman in her early twenties with purple eyes and wears black-and-violet robes. Her abilities include attacking the minds of enemies, animating an army of silver ghosts through her will, and utilizing a colorless [[Striker technique]]. She is also skilled in craftsmanship, having created a [[Goldsteel|goldsteel]] statue of [[Ekeri]]. In her role as a leader and representative, she selects [[Underlord|Underlords]] to represent [[Akura clan|Akura]] vassal states in tournaments. She possesses the ability to influence others' directions and has demonstrated significant power in combat, such as clashing her will against the techniques of a [[Dreadgod]]. [[Charity]] is also related to [[Mercy]], who is her niece.}}
